facts.subject: main/melee/ft/kinds/ftCommon/ftCo_FallAerial:ftCo_FallAerial_Anim
facts.old_value: Each animation update normalizes horizontal velocity by maximum air drift and clamps it to [-1, 1]. At or below a configured magnitude threshold it selects the neutral FallAerial motion with zero target blend; above the threshold it selects the forward or backward motion according to velocity relative to facing and scales the target blend from the threshold to full drift. The persistent blend approaches that target at a configured rate. Once nonzero, a changed selected motion is installed at the current animation frame and its translation-root animation is blended according to the updated value.
